fusions.name: Thundering Pass
fusions.desc: Cuts through a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage to everything in it and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Ride Them Down
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 30% health, dealing 20 damage plus the remaining damage of every affliction on it, which this blow uses up. Your movement speed rises 25% for 5 seconds after.

fusions.name: Full Gallop
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds, with +5% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Gathered Charge
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
